jurisdiction: Dirección de Protección de Datos Personales (DIPRODAP)
key_requirements: Consent, data quality & security, data subject rights (access, rectification, objection, deletion)
enforcement_authority: Dirección de Protección de Datos Personales (DIPRODAP), not yet operational
penalties_range: Art. 46: sanctions are warning, temporary suspension of operations, temporary/permanent closure or cancellation of files; law sets no fixed fine amounts
exemptions: Art. 24: police/army intelligence may process data without consent for national security, defence, public security or crime investigation; Art. 27: opinion polls and scientific/medical research excluded (express consent)
research_exemption: Sensitive data may be processed for statistical or scientific purposes when data subjects cannot be identified (Art. 8(a)); Art. 27 excludes scientific or medical research done with express consent
